subject: english
question:
**You are preparing a speech for an upcoming function. Select a synonym for the highlighted word to make it better.**

Sexual assault is a severe and __pervasive__ issue that can have a significant impact on a victim’s life.
solution:
The correct answer is '**option 3**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pervasive **means that is present in all parts of something. (सर्वत्र, व्‍याप्‍त, व्‍यापक)

 
 
• **Example**- "the pervasive influence of Picasso in his work was clear to see"
 
 
 
• **Widespread **means found or happening over a large area; affecting a large number of people. (दूर-दूर तक फैला हुआ, व्‍याप्‍त; अनेक लोगों को प्रभावित करने वाला, व्‍यापक)
 
 
• **Example**- "drug use is widespread"
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**' which is ''***widespread***'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Retrospective **means the act of thinking now about something in the past: a time/mood of retrospection. (पूर्वप्रभावी)
 
• **Longitudinal **means placed or running lengthwise. (अनुदैर्ध्य).
 
• **Equitorial **means near the imagined line around the center of the earth (the equator). (भूमध्य रेखा के निकट का)
